styles.name: Wagamama white skull cap, revised larger fit — mesh oval crown, velcro adjustable, Wagamama logo in white
styles.desc: SKULL HAT · Revised larger fit · Mesh oval crown · Longer velcro fastened tab at centre back for adjustment, revised cut length of hook and loop velcro · Tibard tax tab right side of the hat as worn · Wagamama logo in white, front off-centre to the right as worn
fabrics: White 65% recycled polyester / 35% organic cotton 200 gsm X133ECO-AM101 (Tiajo) — rating 0.12 m from All Costings
White 100% polyester mesh (Philip Whitfield & Sons) — oval crown, rating 0.04 m as the red
trims: White 16 mm hook velcro, cut at 11 cm (set to the back of the hat, end level with the back split).
White 16 mm loop velcro, cut at 7 cm (on the tab). Sage holds the hook only; no code for the loop yet.
THREAD — WHITE PERMA CORE 75 20000 M CONE 32109W (Somac) — cost per metre (the hat sheets say Coats Epic 80's; Sage holds white as the Perma Core)

Tibard tax tab set to the right side of the hat as worn. Stitch in white thread on top and spool in thread to match the hat. Set with the green check of the label to the top. Set the edge of the label to the bottom edge of the hat and 1 cm from the secured end of the tab. Fold in one side of the label to neaten. Edgestitch all round.

Tibard printed care label, set into the centre back crown. Composition to state 65% recycled polyester 35% organic cotton; mesh 100% polyester · 60° wash · 2 dot iron · tumble dry · do not bleach · P dry clean. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
mfg: Make the velcro tab. Set the loop velcro 12 mm from the end of the tab edge, level with the centre fold of the tab. Edgestitch the loop velcro to the tab. Bag out both ends. Edgestitch the lower edge of the tab to close the tab.
Join the centre back seam panel and notch into the end of the seam. Bag out the slits.
Stitch along the top edge to secure the plies together and set the care label / batch label.
5 thread join the crown to the panel. Notch = centre front and centre back.

Set the velcro tab to the back of the hat, right side as worn. Set the tab so there is a 3.5 cm gap between the end of the loop velcro and the base of the hat split, to allow for adjustment. Edgestitch all round the tab to secure it to the hat.
Edgestitch the back split.
Set the hook velcro to the back of the hat. End of the velcro to be level with the back split. Edgestitch all round the velcro.

Set the Tibard tax tab: white thread on top, spool to match the hat, green check to the top of the label, edge of the label to the bottom edge of the hat and 1 cm from the secured end of the tab. Fold in the side of the label to neaten. Edgestitch all round.
fin: Bartack horizontal at the top of the split.
styles.brandPlace: Wagamama logo 3 cm in white (the star also in white), front off-centre to the right side of the hat as worn: centre of the logo 2.2 cm up from the bottom edge of the hat. Logo set after make-up.
styles.note: Derived from the red WAGHTM016007 sheet (stock works order 1156, JH 2023 to 2026): no sheet for the white hat is on file. The cloth is the one All Costings costs this code on; the mesh and thread are picked to match the colour and are to be confirmed; the velcro, tax tab, labels, make-up and chart are the red sheet's. The logo is white on the red sheet: the colour on the white hat is to be confirmed. The red sheet is in works-orders/WAGHTM016007-Wagamama.xlsx.

styles.name: Shroud, white — 5 thread join, unfinished edges, with 3 ties
styles.desc: SHROUD · One seam, 5 thread joined · 2 x selvedge and 2 x cut edges, left unfinished · 3 x separate ties at 1.60 m · Respect FFMA printed label in the seam · No embroidery
styles.lectra: No pattern: cut 2 at 1.43 m width (including the selvedge) x 1.85 m length, plus 2 long strips 40 mm wide — 5.00 m of strip per shroud (3 x 1.60 m plus shrinkage)
fabrics: White 65% polyester / 35% cotton 195 gsm (P and R) — rating 3.70 m; the sheet names PC2001, All Costings has the sustainable PC2001ECO at 3.70 m
trims: THREAD — WHITE PERMA CORE 75 20000 M CONE 32109W (Somac) — cost per metre (the sheet says Coats Epic 80's white; Sage holds white as the Perma Core)

Respect FFMA printed label (RESPECT · FFMA · Company ID 000282 · Product ID 000202), saved on Gail's printer in the Jacket folder. Insert into the 5 thread join seam, 4 cm from the start. Printed at Tibard on the 25 mm nylon label tape.
Bag, sealed, with the product sticker (Respect CV-19 Shroud, White, UH 1.08 kg) to the bottom right-hand corner. No bag code on the sheet.
mfg: 5 thread join the cut edges together, the selvedges to the outer edges. Insert the printed label into the seam 4 cm from the start.
Make the ties using the binder: fold in the raw edges of the cut strip. Allow to relax and cut to length at 1.60 m, cut straight (not angled).
fin: Check, trim and fold the shroud into the bag: fold selvedge to selvedge, then selvedge to seam, then selvedge to fold; fold in half lengthways and fold the ends in, leaving a gap in the middle for the ties.
3 ties at 1.60 m: loosely fold the ties up together, tie the loose end round the middle and tuck the end inside to secure. Set the ties in the centre of the shroud. Insert in the bag.
Seal the bag and set the product sticker to the bottom right-hand corner of the bag.
styles.note: Works order SHROUD01, the Respect shroud (JH created 30/3/20 for SR894; bag sticker revised 6/4/20; 5 thread join and unfinished edges JH 6/4/20). Rating 3.70 m, the same as All Costings on PC2001ECO. The thread figure is an estimate: there is no standard for a shroud. The sheet's cut diagram, the label and the sticker are in works-orders/SHROUD01-Shroud.xlsx.
